{{Top|leg}}
The '''Recycling Sector''' was a region of the [[Darkside (sector)|Darkside]] district of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. Refuse originating in the upper levels of Coruscant constantly rained down into the Recyling Sector and some of the dumped material was recovered and sent to Darkside's [[Industrial Sector (Coruscant)|Industrial Sector]].
